research:
I searched the web for AI news from 31 Oct to 14 Nov 2026 that a beginner in India could use or would wonder about. I found 9 usable items. For most of them I couldn't find the company's own page, so the facts come from news sites. I've marked which is which.

**New tools and features**

1. **ChatGPT can make GIFs now (Images 2.6, 4 Nov).** You can turn a text prompt or an uploaded photo into a looping animation, and change its speed. *Why it matters:* it's free fun for WhatsApp stickers and shop promos. *The catch:* reports disagree on whether free users get it or only paid plans, and it's still rolling out. I couldn't find OpenAI's own note about GIFs, so check before posting. ([TechRepublic](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-chatgpt-images-2-6-gif-creation/), [OpenAI help page](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes))
2. **Gemini can now order food and book cabs inside other apps in India (beta, 10 Nov).** *Why it matters:* this is the first "AI that uses your phone for you" feature in India. *The catch:* it only works on Pixel 10 phones (not the 10a), for users 18 and over, in English, and you confirm each order yourself. Google's post doesn't spell out the India details; those come from news sites. ([Google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/devices/pixel/november-2026-pixel-drop/), [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/amp/technology/tech-news/google-november-2026-pixel-drop-gemini-intelligence-pixel-tag-features-126111200342_1.html))
3. **Pixel and some Android phones get Hindi summaries and "Rambler" voice typing (10 Nov).** Rambler turns messy speech into tidy text. *Why it matters:* it's built into the phone and needs no new app. *The catch:* only on some Pixel, Motorola and Samsung phones, rolling out over several weeks. ([Google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/devices/pixel/november-2026-pixel-drop/), [Analytics Insight](https://www.analyticsinsight.net/news/google-gemini-expands-in-india-7-new-ai-features-arrive-on-android))
4. **WhatsApp is testing separate Meta AI chats (4 Nov).** You can give each chat its own name and photo, and an "AI" filter in the chat list finds them. *Why it matters:* WhatsApp is the AI most Indians already have. *The catch:* it's an Android beta (2.26.44.6) with no date for everyone, and the source is WABetaInfo, not Meta. ([WABetaInfo](https://wabetainfo.com/whatsapp-is-rolling-out-chats-powered-by-meta-ai-on-android/))
5. **ChatGPT Wallet lets the AI shop and pay for you (13 Nov).** *Why a beginner would wonder:* "Can AI spend my money?" *The answer:* not in India. It's only for US Pro subscribers with a US card. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/openai-chatgpt-wallet-dot-purchases.html), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/13/chatgpts-new-wallet-lets-ai-agents-shop-and-check-out-for-you/))

**Confusion and how-tos**

6. **ChatGPT's Advanced and Standard voice modes are being retired on 11 Dec 2026.** *Why it matters:* people who talk to ChatGPT will ask what changes. This came from search summaries of OpenAI's release notes, so confirm it in the app. ([OpenAI release notes](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes))
7. **How to check if a photo or video was made by AI.** Upload it to Gemini and ask "Was this made with Google AI?" *The catch:* it only spots content made with Google's AI. "Not detected" doesn't mean it's real. Videos must be under 90 seconds and 100 MB. This isn't new, but it fits right next to the scam below. ([Google Support](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16722517))
8. **Your chats may be used to train the AI.** ChatGPT's training setting is on by default for Free, Plus and Pro. Turning it off only covers future chats. In September, OpenAI said its own AI agents posted 53 users' images online (outside your 14 days, but people still ask about it). ([Malwarebytes guide](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/how-to/2026/09/how-to-opt-out-of-ai-chatbot-training), [Axios](https://axios.com/2026/09/25/openai-models-posted-user-images-online-in-latest-security-episode?stream=top))

**Scam**

9. **A fake AI video of Nirmala Sitharaman cost a Kerala woman ₹49.2 lakh (reported 13 Nov).** The video pushed a fake trading app promising ₹90,000 a day on a ₹22,000 start. PIB Fact Check had already flagged it as AI-made on 14 Sep. *Why it matters:* it's a real Indian case with a lesson anyone can use: no minister promises daily returns. Report fraud on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in. I found no new official RBI or I4C warning dated this week. ([Organiser](https://organiser.org/2026/11/13/426021/bharat/fact-check-fake-ai-video-of-nirmala-sitharaman-promises-high-trading-returns-kerala-woman-duped-of-rs-49-2-lakh/), [NewsMobile](https://www.newsmobile.in/fraud-and-scam/kerala-woman-loses-rs-49-2-lakh-in-ai-video-trading-scam/))

**What I left out**
- **A "Gemini 4 Hydrogen" model:** only one blog mentions it, so I couldn't confirm it exists.
- **Canva, CapCut and NotebookLM:** no launches in these 14 days. Gemini Notebook (the new name for NotebookLM) added free textbooks, including S Chand, on 29 Oct, but only blogs report it.
- **Claude Meetings, Sheets and Whiteboards (10 Nov):** these are work tools. Meetings is only on Team and Enterprise plans, so it's weak for beginners.
- **Free AI plan offers:** none are running for Indian students that I could find. ChatGPT Go's free year closed in January.

**For the slot plan:** items 2, 3 and 7 suit the tool and tutorial slots. Item 9 could be one line inside a list, since the plan has no pure news reels.
